description: The caller's orders on XP, newest first: status, fulfilment status, delivery method, in-hand date, event, seats and the all-in total in dollars -- 'where is my order?', 'when do my tickets arrive?'. get_order_status reads one order by its order_uuid and get_my_tickets lists tickets already delivered; offers the caller placed are in get_my_offers and listings they are selling in list_my_listings. Requires sign-in.

limit.description: How many recent orders to return, 1-50. Defaults to 20.

name: get_my_orders
title: Get My Orders
